#!/usr/bin/env bash
# as <pin 1>
# R1264d D1: a second, unguarded call on the line continued into the pinned one: a pin covers one call.
printf hi |
  (cd "$wt" && claude -p "warm the cache" --model haiku && sudo -u "$agent" -- /usr/bin/env -i HOME="$home" PATH=/usr/bin:/bin \
    claude -p --max-budget-usd "$SPIKE_CALL_BUDGET" --settings "$settings" --model haiku --max-turns 3 --permission-mode dontAsk --allowedTools Bash --setting-sources project) | tail -6
